acceptance: The Velox service starts in the release UAT shard and its cells run.
A start failure records the container log in the shard artifact.
context: Evidence: release-v2 run 40971306663 (tag v0.5.0rc2, commit b1459438d), artifact release-uat-v0.5.0rc2-stage3-query-engines: cells.jsonl, uat_gate_summary.json, validator_rollup.tsv, uat_lifecycle.log and per-cell logs. The artifacts do not keep result JSON, so query-level causes need a local rerun of the named cells. See uat_lifecycle.log lines 58-75.
description: In the stage 3 query-engines shard the image benchbox-velox:dev could not be pulled ('repository does not exist'), was built on the runner, and the velox-connect container exited (1) during compose --wait, so no Velox cell ran. Capture the container log, fix the start failure, and decide whether the image should come from the GHCR mirror instead of a runner build.
